parameters.content:
## Evening summary

Runs once a day at closing time and sends each owner one short summary of their day, built only from register_events: leads captured, bookings made, questions the assistant could not answer, nudges sent. Fully deterministic; no AI writes or rewords it, so the numbers an owner sees are the numbers in the register.

The trigger time below is a single default. In the runtime phase each tenant's summary runs at their own closing time in their own timezone (packs carry both). Re-running is safe: summaries are unique per tenant per day and the insert updates in place.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, timezone FROM tenants WHERE status = 'active';

-- 'Today' is the tenant's local day, not the server's.
SELECT event_type, summary, created_at
FROM register_events
WHERE tenant_id = $1
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE $2)::date
ORDER BY created_at;

INSERT INTO summaries (tenant_id, summary_date, body, stats)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, summary_date)
DO UPDATE SET body = EXCLUDED.body, stats = EXCLUDED.stats;
